acceptance: Completed downloads can be filtered, and metric badges appear only when supported values are present.

items.title: Add aggregated multi-indexer search endpoint

findings: Both aggregate-search routes share one implementation and validation middleware. Query/category lengths and integer limit/offset ranges are checked before indexers run; per-indexer errors remain part of the response.
acceptance: Enabled indexers are queried concurrently with bounded, validated parameters and partial-failure reporting.

items.title: Add centralized config.ts with Zod validation for environment variables

findings: Environment configuration is centralized in a Zod schema and consumed through typed config. The fork explicitly supports SQLite by default and validates DATABASE_URL when Postgres is selected, preserving both supported database modes.
acceptance: Startup settings are validated centrally and exposed through typed configuration, including required values for the selected database mode.

items.title: Cap IGDB search attempts to limit aggressive heuristic fallbacks

findings: IGDB search caps its combined query approaches and word-search fallbacks at five attempts. Tests reset module state and count actual games-endpoint requests, asserting exactly five search attempts.
acceptance: Heuristic IGDB search is bounded to five attempts and the cap is deterministic under tests.

items.title: Add qBittorrent and rTorrent support

findings: qBittorrent and rTorrent clients are implemented with shared hash extraction/normalization; client workflows and regression paths are covered by the downloader test suites.
acceptance: qBittorrent and rTorrent can be configured and used for torrent management.

items.title: Clarify priority-based downloader selection and fallback strategy in UI

findings: The downloader page explains lower-number-is-higher priority and automatic fallback. The backend dispatches through enabled downloaders in priority order and continues when a client fails.
acceptance: Users can understand priority order and automatic fallback behavior.

items.title: Integrate StatsCard component to display global dashboard statistics

findings: The Stats page now shows Total Games, unique Genres, unique Platforms, and Wishlist cards, alongside its existing rating/completion/metadata cards. Counts are tested against duplicate genres/platforms and wanted status.
acceptance: Global library summary cards display total games, unique genres, unique platforms, and wanted games.

items.title: Add detailed view for torrent files and trackers

findings: Download detail views expose file priorities, wanted state, tracker statuses, and announce data. Review found rTorrent requested only five tracker fields while interpreting ten columns, leaving status/error mapping ineffective; the multicall now requests the matching fields, reports updating/error/working states, and falls back for older servers. Tests cover the mapping and fallback.
acceptance: Download details show meaningful file and tracker information without polling repeatedly after errors.

items.title: [WIP] Implement minimal qBittorrent client with auth and torrent management

findings: This closed WIP qBittorrent client is superseded by merged PR #119, which implements qBittorrent and rTorrent support with shared hash handling and current regression coverage.
acceptance: The abandoned minimal qBittorrent work is replaced by a complete supported client.

acceptance: A visible progress indicator appears while cached carousel results refresh.
Assistive technology receives a clear update announcement.

Keyboard navigation cannot focus stale carousel controls during refresh.

items.title: ⚡ Bolt: Lazy Load GameCard Images for Faster Initial Load

findings: GameCard cover images already use the browser's lazy-loading behavior.
acceptance: Cover images below the initial viewport are marked for lazy loading.

items.title: 🛡️ Sentinel: Remove database URL from config endpoint

findings: The authenticated GET /api/config response omits the database URL and database connection fields. The shared Config contract and Settings page also contain no database URL field.
acceptance: The public configuration response exposes no database URL or connection string.

items.title: ⚡ Bolt: Debounce Discover Page Filters

findings: Genre and platform selections feed through 300 ms debounced values in the carousel query keys and fetch functions.
acceptance: Changing a genre or platform waits 300 ms before triggering its discovery query.

items.title: 🎨 Palette: Add opacity transition during data refetch

findings: GameCarouselSection combines transition-opacity with opacity-50 during background refetches, so stale results dim smoothly while the refresh indicator is shown.
acceptance: Carousel opacity changes smoothly while the current results refresh.

items.title: 🛡️ Sentinel: Harden config endpoint to prevent information disclosure

findings: The authenticated /api/config response contains no database URL, database host/type/user, or partial API key. It returns provider configured/source flags and a non-secret XREL API base.
acceptance: Configuration reads do not disclose database connection details or partial credentials.

items.title: ⚡ Bolt: Conditionally Render Modals in GameCard

findings: GameCard lazy-loads both modal modules and mounts each modal subtree only while its corresponding open state is true.
acceptance: Closed GameDetailsModal and GameDownloadDialog instances are not mounted in every card.

items.title: 🎨 Palette: Sync carousel title with content on fetch

findings: Discover now uses the same debounced genre/platform value for each carousel heading, query key, and fetch function. A regression test confirms the old label remains during debounce and the new label appears with its loading state and matching query.
acceptance: A filter change never relabels results from the previous genre or platform.
The new heading and corresponding query key change together after debounce.

items.title: 🛡️ Sentinel: Harden config endpoint

findings: The authenticated /api/config response omits the server object and environment details. The shared Config contract has no server field.
acceptance: Configuration reads do not disclose host, port, or runtime environment details.

items.title: 🎨 Palette: Add clear button and ARIA label to SearchBar

findings: The old SearchBar has been replaced by PageToolbar, which provides a labeled controlled search input and a conditional, labeled Clear search button across the Library, Playing, Calendar, and Wishlist pages.
acceptance: Search has a descriptive accessible name and a clear action appears only when the field is non-empty.

items.title: ⚡ Bolt: Refactor duplicated debouncing logic to a reusable hook

findings: The shared generic useDebounce hook is used for genre, platform, and RAWG search values, replacing duplicated timer effects.
acceptance: Discover filter values debounce before requests and share one reusable hook implementation.

items.title: 🛡️ Sentinel: Harden /api/config endpoint

findings: The authenticated /api/config response has no database connection object, and Settings no longer displays the database URL or connection state. The page has explicit loading and error branches.
acceptance: Configuration and Settings do not disclose database connection details, and initial loading terminates with either content or an error state.

items.title: ⚡ Bolt: Refactor Dashboard to useDebounce hook

findings: This refactor targets Dashboard.tsx, which is absent from QuestarrNG separate-page navigation. Discover and Search use the shared debounce hook for their current search flows.
acceptance: There is no Dashboard search effect to replace; the applicable search pages already share the debounce hook.

items.title: 🎨 Palette: Debounce search input to improve UX

findings: SearchPage applies the shared useDebounce hook at 500 ms. The indexer request key, request function, and enabled condition all use the debounced term; the library match query uses it too. Hook tests cover delay, rapid changes, and timer cleanup.
acceptance: Typing waits 500 ms before search requests run, and a newer value cancels the previous pending update.

items.title: chore(deps-dev): bump the dev-dependencies group across 1 directory with 13 updates

findings: The PR was closed without merge. Dependabot noted the updates were available another way; QuestarrNG package manifests and lockfiles now use newer versions than all ten requested updates.
acceptance: Keep the current dependency set; none of the PR older version pins need to be backported.

items.title: Harden Health Check Endpoint

findings: The liveness endpoint returns only a generic status. The readiness endpoint keeps database and IGDB details in server logs and returns only a generic error status with HTTP 503 when checks fail.
acceptance: Health responses contain no database or IGDB status fields; readiness failure is generic and non-200.

items.title: ⚡ Bolt: Add in-memory cache to IGDB client

findings: The IGDB client caches responses by endpoint and normalized query with explicit TTLs, including 15-minute search results and one-hour catalog requests. A regression test confirms a repeated popular-games request reuses the cached payload without another IGDB request.
acceptance: Repeated identical IGDB requests within the TTL avoid duplicate API calls.

items.title: 🎨 Palette: Add tooltips to GameCard icons

findings: GameCard metadata tooltips now expose accessible image names and can be reached by keyboard. Rating, personal rating, and release-date triggers show a visible focus ring; the running UI screenshot captures the focused rating tooltip.
acceptance: Rating and release-date tooltip triggers participate in keyboard focus order and retain accessible labels.

items.title: 🛡️ Sentinel: Harden health check endpoint

findings: The fork separates the always-200 /api/health liveness response from /api/ready. Readiness checks database and IGDB dependencies but returns only a generic status, with HTTP 503 on failure.
acceptance: Liveness stays independent of dependencies, and readiness failures do not disclose which dependency failed.

items.title: Fix drizzle-zod and zod version mismatch

findings: QuestarrNG uses drizzle-zod 0.8.x with Zod 4, the compatible version family identified by the PR. Runtime insert schemas are generated with createInsertSchema, and InsertUser, InsertGame, InsertIndexer, and InsertDownloader are inferred from those schema outputs.
acceptance: Validation schemas and insert types share the same definitions without a Zod 3/4 type mismatch.

items.title: Fix SidebarRail cursor selectors

findings: SidebarRail uses standard Tailwind arbitrary variants for left/right side attributes, including expanded and collapsed resize directions. The fork uses Tailwind 4.
acceptance: The resize cursor follows the rail side and collapsed state using selectors supported by the current Tailwind version.

items.title: ⚡ Bolt: Normalize cache key for improved hit rate

findings: IGDB cache keys normalize query whitespace and trim the result before lookup. Regression coverage confirms formatting-only whitespace differences reuse the cached response without a duplicate API call.
acceptance: Queries that differ only in whitespace share the same cache entry.

items.title: 🎨 Palette: Add empty state to game carousel

findings: GameCarouselSection keeps its title visible and displays a No games found message when a successful query returns no items. A regression test asserts the empty section and message.
acceptance: An empty carousel is distinguishable from a missing or loading section.

items.title: 🛡️ Sentinel: [HIGH] Fix Path Traversal in Download Path

findings: Downloader settings and torrent download validators reject download paths containing parent-directory traversal. Regression tests cover both update and torrent-request paths.
acceptance: Traversal paths are rejected with HTTP 400 before reaching downloader or torrent handlers.

items.title: 🎨 Palette: Add ARIA labels to header buttons

findings: The notifications button has an accessible name that includes the unread count when present; the icon-only theme button is labeled Toggle theme.
acceptance: Screen readers can identify both icon-only header controls and the notification count.

items.title: ⚡ Bolt: Normalize IGDB cache keys to improve cache hit rate

findings: Genre and platform query conditions are sorted before request caching, so equivalent filter sets in different orders reuse the same IGDB response. Regression tests cover both APIs.
acceptance: Reordering genre or platform filters does not create duplicate IGDB requests.

items.title: 🎨 Palette: Add loading spinner to Discover page dropdowns

findings: Discover records isFetching for both static filter queries and shows an animated Loader2 icon in each SelectTrigger while its list is loading.
acceptance: Both dropdowns visibly communicate list loading without replacing their current values.

items.title: 🛡️ Sentinel: [HIGH] Fix Path Traversal in Downloader Clients

findings: Transmission and rTorrent reject unsafe per-download path overrides before external requests. Absolute configured downloader roots remain supported, while request overrides must be relative and contain no parent-directory segments. The upstream PR was closed as a duplicate of earlier path-traversal work.
acceptance: Unsafe override paths do not reach either torrent client, and configured absolute roots still work.

items.title: ⚡ Bolt: Cache IGDB search results to improve performance

findings: IGDB search results are cached after processing using the sanitized query, limit, and all local filtering options as the key. Successful results last 15 minutes and empty results last 5 minutes; API failures do not cache an empty result.
acceptance: Repeated identical searches avoid rerunning the search approaches without leaking results across platform or release-year filters.

items.title: 🎨 Palette: Add Tooltips to Carousel Navigation Buttons

findings: Carousel previous/next controls already expose explanatory tooltips, including First page reached and Last page reached when disabled. Added a regression test for that guidance.
acceptance: Users can identify carousel navigation actions and why a disabled control cannot move further.

items.title: 🛡️ Sentinel: [HIGH] Fix Path Traversal Vulnerability

findings: Per-download request paths reject absolute POSIX and Windows paths plus parent-directory segments. Downloader configuration continues to accept an absolute root path while rejecting traversal.
acceptance: A request cannot replace the configured root with an absolute or parent-traversing destination.

items.title: ⚡ Bolt: Add Caching to IGDB Game Search

findings: The processed-search cache includes successful and empty results. Regression tests confirm a repeated empty query skips the search approaches and different local year filters remain isolated.
acceptance: Repeated searches reuse cached results while preserving local filter semantics.

items.title: 🎨 Palette: Add tooltips to disabled carousel buttons

acceptance: A disabled previous/next control remains discoverable and explains why navigation is unavailable.

items.title: Fix Path Traversal Vulnerability

acceptance: Absolute and parent-traversing download overrides are rejected before a downloader request is made.

items.title: ⚡ Bolt: Cache IGDB searchGames results

findings: IGDB search results are cached by sanitized query, limit, and local filter options; successful results use a 15-minute TTL and empty results use 5 minutes.
acceptance: Repeated equivalent searches reuse results, distinct local options do not collide, and failed API calls do not create empty cache entries.

items.title: 🎨 Palette: Add tooltip to sidebar trigger

acceptance: The sidebar trigger exposes a readable tooltip label.

items.title: Support smart adding of game

findings: When the user chooses a main release, updates start selected; extras are suggested only when their measured positive size is no more than 25% of the main release, and stay unchecked. Larger and unknown-size extras are omitted. Item sizes are shown, selected companions can be sent with the main release, and Download game only remains available. The threshold is a transparent conservative reading of “a lot smaller,” not a compatibility guarantee.
acceptance: Show a bundle choice when a main release has updates or size-qualified extras; default updates to selected and extras to unchecked; show sizes; allow sending selected companions or the main game alone.

items.title: Allow extended search

acceptance: Users can switch among year/month/week views and see wanted games with announced or TBA dates.

acceptance: License terms, contribution guidance, and documentation are available in the repository.

items.title: auto own when torrent is completed

acceptance: Completing the main-game download automatically marks the game as owned.

items.title: allow direct download of torrent

findings: Search results now expose a clearly labeled direct file-download action for safe HTTP(S) torrent/NZB links, separately from sending the release to a configured downloader. Magnet-only results do not show the file action. Selecting a main game with updates retains the update-choice step; mobile release titles now wrap at word boundaries.
acceptance: Users can download a torrent/NZB file from a result, distinguish that action from adding to a downloader, and still choose whether to include updates.

items.title: Delayed games

findings: Scheduled release checks request IGDB release-date status names, recognize an explicit future Delayed status, preserve date-shift detection as a fallback, and notify when the game transitions to delayed.
acceptance: Delayed games have a distinct calendar state and users receive a notification when a release becomes delayed.

items.title: display downloaders free storage in header

findings: The header displays free storage for configured downloaders using the existing storage API.
acceptance: Users can see configured download targets’ available storage from the application header.

items.title: Implement a scheduled search for game torrents

findings: Optional scheduled search targets wanted games that are neither owned nor already downloading; interval, enablement, auto-download, and user notifications are configurable.
acceptance: Users can enable scheduled searches, configure their interval and auto-download preference, and be notified when multiple main results or owned-game updates are found.

items.title: Review the UI of the game details

findings: The details dialog reserves space for the close control and uses a compact inline cover to avoid overlap and excessive empty space.
acceptance: The game image does not cover the close control, and the title-to-details layout avoids large blank areas.

items.title: Harden repository: Fix tests, update docs, and improve code style

The fork intentionally uses npm/package-lock, so its later tooling state supersedes the PR’s pnpm-only documentation change; format, lint, type-check, and focused test checks pass.

items.title: 🎨 Palette: [UX improvement] Add aria-labels to notification buttons

findings: Notification Center icon-only actions have explicit accessible names: “Mark all notifications as read” and “Clear all notifications.”
acceptance: Screen-reader users can identify the bulk mark-read and clear actions.

items.title: ⚡ Bolt: optimize metadata refresh with batched API calls

findings: The metadata refresh endpoint uses one IGDB getGamesByIds request per batch and writes updates in bounded chunks instead of issuing one metadata request per game.
acceptance: Refresh library metadata without N+1 IGDB requests and limit concurrent database updates.

items.title: Repo hardening: fix lint/format issues, repair broken test, and update dependencies

findings: The PR was closed without merge. Its substantive changes are present in the current npm-based fork: @eslint/js is declared, nanoid is a production dependency, the GameDownloadDialog test mock includes SlidersHorizontal, and formatting/lint/type/test checks pass. Current npm/package-lock usage also reflects the maintainer’s follow-up request to stop using pnpm.
acceptance: Keep the server dependency declared for production, make the test suite and lint/format/build checks pass, and use the repository’s npm toolchain.

items.title: Iterative Hardening: Fix tests, lint, and add docs

findings: The PR was closed without merge. The current repository supplies the equivalent operational and contribution guidance in docs/OPERATIONS.md and .github/CONTRIBUTING.md, a supported .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md, and an active upstream-resolution task ledger. The subsequent repository standard is npm, and no stale pnpm policy appears in the checked repository docs and local memory files.
acceptance: Provide operational guidance and a PR template while following the maintainer’s npm decision.

items.title: Support for Usenet

findings: Prowlarr synchronization accepts both torrent and Usenet indexers and maps them to Torznab/Newznab. Search results preserve the download type and Usenet metadata; the download path only tries SABnzbd/NZBGet for Usenet results.
acceptance: Support Usenet indexers in configuration and search, then route NZB results to Usenet downloaders.

items.title: Smart release management

findings: Installed-version tracking is per library entry: users can edit it, release names suggest versions, and completed/imported base-game or edition downloads advance it only when the parsed version is newer. Scheduled searches suppress update results that are provably equal to or older than the installed version. Each game can select a target platform for matching; edition releases contribute to that game entry’s version.
acceptance: Let users provide an installed version when it cannot be determined from files, learn versions from release names after completed downloads, and alert only when a newer update is available. Version and platform scope is per library entry; no binary inspection is assumed.

items.title: Feature/usenet-support

findings: The merged Usenet-support PR’s core behavior is present in the fork: Newznab parsing, Usenet indexer configuration and search, SABnzbd/NZBGet downloader support, download-type routing, and the associated lifecycle/status handling.
acceptance: Support Newznab search and route NZB results to supported Usenet clients while preserving torrent flows.

items.title: Error [ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND]: Cannot find package 'nanoid' imported from /app/dist/server/vite.js

findings: The original error was a missing production nanoid import. Later comments report first-start migrations and an absent drizzle-kit binary; the production image resolves nanoid and contains both migration journals, and the fresh-container smoke test applied migrations and passed health. The final comment uses localhost for PostgreSQL inside the app container, which is a DB-host configuration problem rather than a missing application dependency; related container networking guidance is in #260.
acceptance: The production image resolves nanoid and starts with its migration assets included; first-start migration and health behavior are verified, and container DB host configuration is documented as an operator setting.

items.title: Add new logger and fix drizzle-kit dependency issue

findings: PR #239 proposed adding an appLogger export and shipping drizzle-kit at runtime for startup schema pushes. The fork instead applies versioned SQLite/PostgreSQL migrations through its own startup migration runners and uses the existing structured logger, so neither proposed change is needed in production.
acceptance: Production startup applies the app migrations without invoking drizzle-kit.
The migration module imports an exported logger and the production TypeScript build passes.

items.title: > questarr@1.0.0 db:push > drizzle-kit push sh: drizzle-kit: not found

findings: The reported production image ran npm run db:push without a drizzle-kit binary. The current container starts the compiled server directly; server startup applies its own tracked SQLite/PostgreSQL migrations, and drizzle-kit remains a development-only schema authoring tool.
acceptance: The production entrypoint does not invoke db:push or require drizzle-kit.
Application startup migration behavior is covered by migration tests.

items.title: ./logger.js has no exported member named 'applogger'

acceptance: The compiled server type-checks with the current migration logger import and cron types.

items.title: Not adding to qBittorrent behind Gluetun VPN

findings: The upstream follow-up in PR #276 supports VPN-isolated qBittorrent clients by fetching the torrent file in Questarr and uploading it to qBittorrent. If qBittorrent accepts a request but Questarr cannot confirm the torrent yet, the client now returns its correlation tag and an explicit unconfirmed message instead of a fabricated title-as-ID success; both download entry points show a checking message that tells users to inspect qBittorrent before retrying. Free-space lookup falls back to server-state data when the path-specific API is unavailable.
acceptance: A qBittorrent instance that cannot fetch the indexer URL can receive an uploaded torrent file from Questarr.
An accepted but unconfirmed add stays identifiable by correlation tag and is presented as pending confirmation, with guidance to check qBittorrent before retrying.
Free-space lookup has a server-state fallback for unsupported path-specific responses.

items.title: ⚡ Bolt: Parallelize fallback search in IGDB client

findings: IGDB fallback word searches use Promise.all, input-sanitizing regexes are module-level constants, and only the remaining portion of the five-attempt budget is searched.
acceptance: Fallback requests run concurrently and the total request-attempt cap remains five.

items.title: 🎨 Palette: [UX improvement] Fix NotificationItem accessibility

acceptance: Notification rows are focusable and activatable with Enter/Space without acting as form-submit buttons.

findings: GET /api/downloads and GET /api/downloaders/storage start enabled-downloader requests together with Promise.all. Each downloader is handled independently, so a failed client does not fail the whole response or discard successful clients.
acceptance: Downloader status and free-space requests run concurrently.
Partial client failures are reported per downloader while successful results remain available.

items.title: Error Adding Usenet Download Via Prowlarr

findings: The reporter tested the upstream fix and closed the issue after NZBs were accepted. The fork accepts HTTP and HTTPS NZB links, preserves downloadType=usenet from search, and dispatches them to SABnzbd or NZBGet instead of torrent-only handling.
acceptance: A Prowlarr Usenet result can be added to a configured Usenet downloader without an Invalid torrent URL error, while torrent and Usenet requests remain routed to matching client types.

items.title: Downloader field behaviour alignment

findings: Downloader setup now uses a consistent Host field and separate Port and Use SSL controls for supported client types, with type- and TLS-aware port defaults and client-specific setup guidance. This is more complete than the upstream field-label cleanup.
acceptance: Downloader forms communicate host, port, and TLS behavior consistently and show sensible defaults and instructions for the selected client.

items.title: GitHub sidepanel link

findings: The sidebar links to the QuestarrNG repository and displays the running version; it checks the latest QuestarrNG release and shows an update indicator when appropriate. The implementation is adapted to this fork rather than querying the upstream Questarr package.

items.title: ⚡ Bolt: Implement route-based code splitting

findings: All route pages are loaded with React.lazy inside a shared Suspense boundary, and the production build emits separate page chunks with a loading fallback.
acceptance: Route components are split from the entry bundle, and navigating to them retains the existing route behavior while chunks load.

items.title: 🛡️ Sentinel: [security improvement] Harden server with Helmet and DB pool settings

findings: The server applies Helmet with a tailored Content Security Policy and other security headers. The optional Postgres pool has a configurable bounded size, connection and statement timeouts, minimum capacity validation for migrations, and idle-client error logging; these controls are more specific than the upstream fixed pool defaults.
acceptance: Security headers protect the app without breaking required resources, and Postgres connection waits and queries are bounded with pool capacity validated at startup.

items.title: 🛡️ Sentinel: [HIGH] Fix SSRF in bundle download

findings: The merged upstream check was present, but the fork intentionally allows private addresses by default for self-hosted integrations, so that check alone still allowed arbitrary internal bundle targets. The bundle endpoint now defaults to public targets and permits private access only for an exact configured indexer origin; safeFetch applies the same policy to every redirect.
acceptance: An authenticated bundle request cannot fetch arbitrary private or loopback URLs; configured private indexer origins continue to work, and redirects cannot pivot to another internal host.

items.title: 🎨 Palette: [UX improvement]

findings: The carousel refresh control already has the requested accessible name; a role-based test now locks in the exact name for assistive technology.
acceptance: The icon-only refresh action is exposed as a button named Refresh games.

items.title: Error on attempting download?

findings: The report began with the download endpoint receiving a temporary igdb-* discovery ID where it requires a library UUID. The dialog now creates or reuses the library game before dispatching the download, and the reporter later confirmed the issue was resolved after rebuilding and correcting the deployment setup.
acceptance: A download started from Discover sends a real library UUID and does not fail validation on the temporary metadata ID.

items.title: Can't update indexers

findings: Indexer URL validation accepts configured localhost and internal HTTP(S) services. Prowlarr sync leaves per-indexer categories out when no global override is selected, storage preserves existing values, and Newznab search sends and filters by the saved categories. The reporter confirmed the category results were corrected.
acceptance: Users can update a local Prowlarr-backed indexer and retain category choices through sync; those categories constrain both Torznab and Newznab game results.

items.title: Add ROM Support

findings: The fork supports retro discovery and ROM workflows: Discover can search the optional RAWG catalog, platform mappings cover common console generations, and completed files can be routed to a configured RomM ROM library with conflict and destination review.
acceptance: Users can discover older titles through the available catalog provider, track their platform, and import a matched ROM release into the configured RomM platform folder.

items.title: ⚡ Bolt: Parallelize download bundle fetching

findings: Bundle downloads fetch results in chunks of five with Promise.all, so independent files are fetched concurrently without an unbounded request fan-out. Individual failures are logged and do not discard successful files.
acceptance: Bundle response time benefits from bounded parallel fetching and a failed file does not abort the remaining bundle.

items.title: 🛡️ Sentinel: [CRITICAL] Fix SSRF in download bundle endpoint

findings: This closed unmerged PR repeats PR #267's isSafeUrl guard, which permits private IPs by default in this self-hosted fork. The stronger bundle-specific private-origin policy and redirect checks now resolve the vulnerability without blocking configured LAN indexers.
acceptance: Prevent arbitrary internal bundle fetches while retaining the legitimate configured-indexer path; the superseding policy must also validate redirects.

items.title: ⚡ Bolt: Cache storage info for 30s

findings: GET /api/downloaders/storage fetches enabled downloader space concurrently and keeps individual failures isolated. It caches the response in memory for 30 seconds; the cache record now has an explicit StorageCacheItem[] shape.
acceptance: The first request fetches each enabled downloader, subsequent requests within the 30-second TTL reuse the response, and an expired entry triggers a fresh lookup.
One downloader failure does not fail the entire storage response.

items.title: Can't find torrents for download, even though the are available and well-seeded on the tracker.

findings: The reporter found that their Prowlarr configuration was automatically excluding .rar results, then apologized for the false alarm. The report did not identify a Questarr defect.
acceptance: The upstream discussion identifies an external indexer configuration as the cause and the reporter closed the support case after finding it; no code change is required.

items.title: Qbittorrent behind vpn fix

findings: The qBittorrent client can download the torrent file from the indexer and upload it to the client when qBittorrent cannot fetch indexer URLs from behind a VPN. It also returns download details and maps client states for the downloads view.
acceptance: A VPN-isolated qBittorrent can receive the torrent through a file upload fallback; torrent details and supported statuses remain available.

items.title: Jules: Repo Hardening & Type Fixes

items.title: trying a fix for #270

items.title: Downloader/indexer list update

Disabled indexers and downloaders remain visible but visually recede, and the downloader name prompt reflects the selected type.

items.title: fix: fix free space widget for qBittorrent

acceptance: A hostname that changes to a private or otherwise unsafe address after validation cannot redirect the outbound request.

items.title: Blacklist wrong releases/search results

acceptance: A user can blacklist a bad release, stop it from resurfacing in relevant searches or automated picks, and remove it later.

items.title: feat: Disable auto-search for unreleased games and allow enabling it optionally

items.title: Update 1.2 to 1.2.2

findings: This PR is a release roll-up to Questarr 1.2.2. Its substantive dependency/security updates are reviewed in PRs #408–419, and its Docker hardening is present in the current fork. Repository and Node engine metadata are adapted to QuestarrNG. The historical version bump, release tag, and release/1.3.0 deployment trigger are superseded by the fork-specific 1.10.0 release line and its current pipeline.
acceptance: All substantive code, security, dependency, package metadata, and container requests are present in current fork form; the old upstream release/tag event is no longer applicable.

items.title: 🛡️ Sentinel: [MEDIUM] Fix error message information leakage

findings: Production 5xx responses already replaced the error message with a generic message, but still serialized err.details. The handler now omits details for all production 5xx errors while logging the untouched error object for diagnosis. Regression coverage exercises 500 and 503 responses and verifies the original details remain in server logs.
acceptance: Production clients receive only the generic error for 5xx responses; internal details remain in server logs; 4xx details remain available.

items.title: ⚡ Bolt: Lazy load game details and download dialogs

findings: Standard and compact game cards lazy-load their details and download dialogs and show visible loading feedback while the dialogs load.
acceptance: Dialog code is deferred until needed and users receive a loading indicator during the transition.

items.title: 🎨 Palette: Add contextual aria-labels to game cards

acceptance: Assistive technology receives game-specific labels for card actions and state.

items.title: Fix Docker container security by adjusting user permissions

findings: The production image defaults to the dedicated unprivileged questarr account. The entrypoint validates the configured UID/GID and writable database, repairs ownership when it starts with the required privilege, and drops privileges with su-exec; rootless mismatches fail with an actionable message.
The upstream review's BuildKit COPY --chmod suggestion was declined because BuildKit is not guaranteed in the supported Docker setup; runtime security behavior is complete.
acceptance: The application runs as a non-root user by default, configured volume ownership is checked before startup, and root-started containers drop privileges before exec.

items.title: Use GitHub Releases API for version check instead of package.json from main

findings: The version service queries the latest QuestarrNG GitHub Release, reads tag_name, normalizes the leading v, and reports rate-limit or request failures without treating the main-branch package version as a release.
acceptance: The update check compares against the latest published release and handles malformed tags and HTTP failures.

items.title: Debrid Support

findings: The issue discussion called Real-Debrid low priority and suggested an external rdtclient adapter to avoid duplicating an existing service. QuestarrNG instead ships first-class Real-Debrid acquisition with device authorization, magnet and torrent-file intake, local staging, and the shared post-processing/import path in version 1.10.0.
acceptance: A user can authorize Real-Debrid, acquire supported magnets or torrent files, stage completed content locally, and hand it to the existing import pipeline.

items.title: Fix session refresh issue on page reload

findings: Authentication state is revalidated from /api/auth/me whenever the provider mounts after a reload. Cookie-backed requests remain the source of truth, and unauthorized responses clear stale client state.
acceptance: Reloading a signed-in page restores the authenticated user; expired or invalid sessions do not leave stale user data in the UI.

items.title: Remove Steam sign-in button & Steam API key + Fix steam wishlist sync

The upstream review's Host-header and shared Passport-strategy race findings apply to the removed sign-in route. Wishlist API error mapping, failure backoff, route tests, and conditional proxy trust are present in the fork.
acceptance: Users can sync a public Steam wishlist without Steam OpenID or a Steam API key; separate owned-game and achievement features may use a server-side key.

acceptance: After add, edit, delete, sync, or enable/disable indexer mutations, subsequent searches use current indexer state; operators can also clear cached download searches from Settings.

SonarCloud reported one security hotspot, but its details endpoint was inaccessible (403); the changed behavior was reviewed locally and the targeted tests passed.
acceptance: Base64 plus characters are percent-escaped only inside the Prowlarr link value across direct and fallback torrent fetch paths; transient torrent errors recover during the grace period; SABnzbd multipart data carries an explicit boundary; HTTPS certificate verification is never silently disabled.

acceptance: The production path is scanned on the required schedule and release branches, reports are retained, and DAST policy and OpenSSF evidence describe the workflow.

findings: The current server narrows font-src/style-src and sets the requested restrictive Permissions-Policy. items.title: Parameterize single-header security tests (SonarCloud S6564)

findings: The requested SonarCloud S6564 cleanup is present: single-header security assertions are parameterized while preserving the expected response-header values.
acceptance: The focused security suite passes and continues to assert the individual security headers.

items.title: qBittorent 5.2 torrent add issue

findings: The qBittorrent 5.2 add-torrent endpoint can return a JSON success body; the adapter parses that response instead of treating it as an unexpected failure.
acceptance: Regression coverage exercises qBittorrent 5.2 response handling and the focused downloader suite passes.

items.title: ⚡ Bolt: Optimize Discover page array traversals

findings: The Discover page uses a stable empty-games value and a single memoized local-games derivation that includes hidden games, avoiding repeated array traversals.
acceptance: Discover page regression tests pass with the optimized derived data and existing filtering behavior intact.

items.title: 🎨 Palette: Replace native title tooltips with UI tooltips in NotificationCenter

findings: NotificationCenter uses the project's tooltip components instead of browser-native title tooltips; disabled controls remain hoverable and keyboard-focusable through wrapper elements.
acceptance: Accessibility tests cover tooltip labels and the disabled-control trigger behavior.

items.title: Fix DAST pipeline: accept CSP style-src unsafe-inline finding

findings: The DAST gate retains its documented style-src unsafe-inline accepted risk and blocks unignored WARN/FAIL alerts. The production-bundle AST check compensates for ZAP rule 10110's text-only false positive on RE2JS's instance method named eval.
acceptance: The production bundle guard passes, and a ZAP 2.17.0 baseline scan of the exact production build with the checked-in rules returns zero new WARN/FAIL alerts. The GitHub-hosted follow-up run is tracked separately in the batch evidence.

items.title: [Support] Import failed when unpacking .rar file

findings: The current image provides RARLAB unrar for RAR archives and Alpine-native 7-Zip for other supported formats. ArchiveService lists and extracts a real RAR archive successfully. Successful move-mode imports remove archive volumes and the emptied source directory; copy and hardlink modes preserve their source data by design.
acceptance: The pinned RARLAB archive checksum matches the downloaded vendor archive, a real archive list/extract smoke test succeeds, and the ImportManager move-mode regression tests verify cleanup.

items.title: Fix 7zip bin permissions in docker file #802

findings: The PR's chmod change targeted the npm 7zip-bin executable, which does not run correctly on Alpine/musl and lacks RAR support. The current implementation installs Alpine-native 7-Zip for supported non-RAR formats and pinned RARLAB unrar for RAR, superseding the proposed binary-permission fix.
acceptance: Issue #802's RAR import behavior is covered by the actual RAR smoke test and archive-import regression tests.

items.title: Add carousel navigation to the screenshot lightbox

findings: The screenshot lightbox carousel wraps through screenshots, supports keyboard and touch navigation, resets safely when the screenshot list changes, and exposes accessible controls and a counter.
acceptance: Game details modal tests cover carousel navigation, wrapping, keyboard behavior, touch interaction, reset behavior, and empty-list guards.

items.title: Add optional auto Steam wishlist sync with configurable interval

findings: Steam wishlist auto-sync is opt-in per user, configurable from 1 to 168 hours, protected against overlapping scheduler runs, and records the last-sync time only on success. User settings are validated server-side, and background refresh does not overwrite unsaved settings edits.
acceptance: Focused tests cover interval boundaries and invalid API values, opt-in scheduling, single-flight behavior, success-only timestamps, and preservation of user edits.

items.title: Shard CI test run across 4 parallel jobs

findings: The four-shard plus merge-job design addressed the older test suite's runtime.

The current workflow deliberately runs the full test plan in one job, about three minutes; four shard jobs plus a merge would consume five runners and five npm installs for similar wall time. Shared concurrent-runner capacity is the binding constraint, so the original sharding design is superseded.
acceptance: The full test plan remains gated by one CI test job without the five-runner sharding overhead.

items.title: Add Windows 2000 style mode

findings: Windows 2000 is available in Settings → Appearance and selection persists through the unified theme key.

The selected theme applies the theme-win2k root class and its retro title bar, square corners, beveled controls, and scrollbar styling; a headless browser visual check confirmed the Settings screen renders in this theme.
acceptance: Selecting Windows 2000 persists the choice and applies the theme class.
The live Settings screen visibly uses the Windows 2000 styling.

items.title: Add adult content filter for erotica/adults-only games

findings: IGDB formatting classifies the Erotic theme separately from ESRB Adults Only and PEGI 18 ratings; both independent user preferences default to hidden.

The server applies filters to library lists/search, IGDB and RAWG discovery, detail lookup, and quick add. User-varying discovery results use private cache policy, and the two persisted flags exist in SQLite and PostgreSQL schemas.
Added regression coverage for Erotic, ESRB AO, PEGI 18, unrelated signals, independent filter combinations, and age-restricted quick-add rejection.
acceptance: Each signal is classified independently and disabling one filter does not disable the other.
Filtered games are omitted from lists and detail/quick-add paths without being added to the library.

items.title: Move archive extraction to the library side, harden multi-volume handling

findings: Move and copy imports relocate the archive family to the library destination before extraction; hardlink and symlink imports extract from the source archive and transfer remaining loose files separately.

The implementation detects downloader-extracted content, handles .partN.rar and other volume families, normalizes cross-platform paths, stages extraction safely, and surfaces extraction failures with recovery guidance.
Import review explains same-volume hardlink fallback and symlink breakage when a source is moved or removed.
acceptance: Archive extraction completes at the library destination for move/copy modes while preserving volume-family integrity and existing library files.
Hardlink/symlink constraints are visible, already-extracted archives are not transferred twice, and failures leave actionable recovery guidance.

items.title: chore(deps): bump the all-actions group with 2 updates

findings: All current workflow references to actions/setup-node use the v7.0.0 commit pin.
The release workflow no longer uses softprops/action-gh-release; it uses the pinned step-security/action-gh-release v3.0.3 action instead, so the old softprops version request is obsolete.
acceptance: The requested setup-node major upgrade is present and release creation uses the current pinned hardened action.

items.title: Search results order not matching indexer priority

findings: The reporter clarified that priority had previously controlled which indexers were queried, then requested an option to sort visible releases by priority.
The download dialog supports Priority sorting: lower configured priority numbers sort first, while indexers without a current priority remain last in either sort direction.
acceptance: Users can sort search results by configured indexer priority, with unknown indexers consistently last.

items.title: Prowlarr download URL double-wrapped when addressed by Docker service name (still fails after #647)

findings: Prowlarr proxy links are recognized by the configured numeric indexer path and the presence of a link token even when the returned host is a private container IP or reverse-proxy alias.
The recognized URL is rewritten to the configured Prowlarr endpoint without nesting its token; the exact Docker service-name-to-172.19.0.8 regression and reverse-proxy variants are covered.
acceptance: A Prowlarr /{id}/download URL returned on an alias preserves its original link token and is passed to the download client without double-wrapping.
Safe network fetches continue pinning validated DNS addresses while preserving the configured hostname for Host/TLS routing.

items.title: ⚡ Bolt: Optimize calculateLibraryStats O(N) traversals

findings: calculateLibraryStats accumulates its metrics in one pass through the games list instead of chaining multiple full-list traversals.
The completeness calculation excludes both null and undefined ratings, retaining the upstream review correction.
acceptance: Statistics preserve existing outputs while traversing the input once and treating missing ratings as incomplete.

items.title: 🎨 Palette: Replace native title attributes with Tooltip in RssFeedList

findings: RSS grid/list toggles use the shared styled Tooltip component instead of native title attributes and keep explicit Grid View/List View accessible names.
Headless browser hover showed the styled List View tooltip, and the RSS feed list accessibility test covers both toggle names and article-link labels.
fast-xml-parser remains a production dependency in the package manifest.
acceptance: Hovering an icon-only view toggle shows its matching styled tooltip while screen readers retain the explicit button name.

items.title: Importing when using Sabnzbd as downloader fails

findings: SABnzbd history resolution prefers its storage field, which points to the final category destination, instead of relying only on a path value that may still name an incomplete directory.
The issue's custom /incomplete-bigstorage path and /downloads/complete/games storage destination have a regression test; the upstream reporter confirmed the fix image worked.
acceptance: When SABnzbd has moved a completed job to a category directory, import uses the final storage path and avoids retrying a stale temporary path.

items.title: chore(deps): bump the npm_and_yarn group across 1 directory with 2 updates

findings: The PR requested fast-xml-parser 5.10.1 and fast-uri 3.1.4. The current production lock resolves 5.11.2 and 3.1.8, so later releases supersede the requested patch versions.
fast-xml-parser remains a production dependency and its XML parsing is covered by the existing Newznab/feed tests.
acceptance: The requested parser and URI-parser updates are present at newer locked versions.

items.title: No import tentative

findings: The report says qBittorrent and Questarr share the same /data mount but provides no qBittorrent version or diagnostic log, so its original installation cannot be reproduced exactly.

The current qBittorrent 5 asynchronous URL-add flow polls for the real hash and uses a correlation tag when the hash is not immediately available. The API creates a game_downloads record for the accepted add, and later resolution makes the completed download visible to the import pipeline.
Regression tests cover asynchronous hash resolution, temporary correlation-tag tracking, and import handling; no missing implementation path was found for the reported no-import symptom.
acceptance: An accepted qBittorrent URL add is tracked before its asynchronous hash appears and can proceed through completion/import handling.

items.title: Game gets stuck on wanted status

findings: The later reporter supplied the concrete Prowlarr Docker URL and error: the configured service hostname was lost on a plain-HTTP safeFetch connection, causing Prowlarr to return a proxy URL that Questarr could wrap again.

safeFetch now pins the validated address while retaining the configured hostname in the URL/Host header. Torznab rewriting preserves the existing token, and the qBittorrent add path tracks the resulting download.
acceptance: Prowlarr receives its configured hostname on plain HTTP and already-proxied download links reach qBittorrent without double-wrapping.

items.title: chore(deps): bump the npm_and_yarn group across 1 directory with 2 updates

findings: The PR requested js-yaml 5.2.2 and body-parser 1.20.6. The current lock resolves js-yaml 5.4.3 and body-parser 2.3.0, superseding both requested versions.
acceptance: Both dependencies are locked at later versions and the production audit passes.

items.title: v1.4.1 hotfix: fix brace-expansion, js-yaml, body-parser vulnerabilities

findings: The hotfix requested brace-expansion 5.0.8, js-yaml 5.2.2, and body-parser 1.20.6 to close production vulnerabilities. The current lock resolves 5.0.12, 5.4.3, and 2.3.0 respectively.
The locked production dependency audit reports zero vulnerabilities, and the current dependency override checks retain the required safe versions.
acceptance: All three vulnerable dependency lines are resolved at newer versions and the production audit has no findings.

items.title: Fix SonarQube supply-chain findings in CI workflows and Dockerfile

findings: Non-runtime CI, SCA, and vulnerability-scan jobs use npm ci --ignore-scripts; runtime build/DAST jobs retain script execution where native modules are needed. Workflow tool calls use locally locked tools rather than on-demand npx installs.

Semgrep is installed from a hash-pinned requirements file. Apprise is hash-pinned at 2.0.1 in the later Python-tooling policy, replacing the PR-era version while preserving reproducible, verified installs. QuestarrNG uses its own locked production-license checker.
acceptance: Non-runtime checks avoid unnecessary lifecycle scripts and dynamic installs; runtime checks retain required native setup; security tooling and Python runtime dependencies are reproducibly pinned.

items.title: Fix safeFetch losing the real Host header on plain-HTTP requests

findings: The fork preserves the requested hostname and TLS identity while pinning connections to the validated IP; an actual loopback HTTP test verifies the Host header, and Torznab tests cover the Prowlarr alias regression.

A 10-second idle cache keyed by validated address and family reuses undici Agents and closes idle pools; tests verify reuse, address separation, and expiry. This addresses the PR review finding about creating a dispatcher per request.

The separate suggestion to remove Undici/DOM type casts was evaluated. Directly exposing Undici types causes incompatibilities in the existing global Response, Headers, and FormData call sites, so the narrow compatibility casts remain at the transport boundary.
acceptance: Plain-HTTP requests retain the configured Host while each connection stays pinned to a freshly validated address; pooled agents are retired after an idle window.

items.title: Fix qBittorrent v5+ downloads not being tracked

findings: The client handles qBittorrent 5 JSON pending/immediate responses, resolves hashes with tag-scoped polling, catches transient lookup errors without resubmitting an accepted torrent, and avoids stacking the helper delay on each poll.

The game-download route persists a correlation tag before the infohash is available. The asynchronous polling timer spy is restored in a finally block, so assertion failures cannot contaminate later tests.
acceptance: Accepted qBittorrent 5 URL adds remain associated with their game and are eventually resolved without duplicate submissions or leaking test timers.

items.title: Fix SABnzbd completed-download path resolution for custom incomplete dirs

findings: SABnzbd history resolution prefers its final storage category path over a stale incomplete path, including custom incomplete-bigstorage directories. The current regression coverage includes the exact issue paths and import behavior.
acceptance: Completed SABnzbd jobs import from the final storage directory when the API supplies it.

items.title: chore(deps-dev): bump the dev-dependencies group across 1 directory with 9 updates

acceptance: Every action still used by the fork is pinned at the requested version or a later compatible version.

items.title: chore(deps): bump the production group across 1 directory with 32 updates

acceptance: Each package in the merged production update group is locked at its requested version or a later compatible version.

items.title: Fix node base image digest to correct node:26-alpine

findings: The fix replaces a Debian digest mistakenly labeled as node:26-alpine. QuestarrNG uses a later pinned node:26-alpine digest; Docker Registry manifest inspection reports Alpine 3.24 as its base and lists linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 variants.
acceptance: The Node 26 base image digest resolves to an Alpine image that provides apk for the Dockerfile's production stage.

items.title: NZBGet questarr category not applied on download start

findings: NZBGet addDownload chooses the request category first, then the configured downloader category, then an empty category. A regression test covers the exact missing-request-category case described by the issue and the configured Questarr category.
acceptance: A download with no per-request category is submitted to NZBGet using the downloader's configured category.

items.title: 500 Internal Error on Importing Completed qBittorrent Download

findings: For qBittorrent single-file torrents, the import path is resolved from the actual file list rather than the torrent display name. The same resolver is used for manual review and the automatic import path, and regression coverage asserts the resulting source filename.

Import failures remain in manual_review_required with a stored reason. PendingImportsCard displays that reason and offers Review, which can edit the source path and retry. The API continues to return a generic response for unexpected exceptions rather than exposing arbitrary internal error text.
acceptance: A single-file torrent without a display-name subfolder resolves to its actual filename for import; an unpack failure stays visible and retryable with a stored reason.

items.title: Unable to re-attempt post-processing/import after a failure

findings: Both automatic processImport failures and user-triggered confirmImport retry failures set manual_review_required and retain the formatted error message. The pending-import endpoint and card keep the item visible; Review opens the confirmation flow again, and another failed attempt remains retryable.
acceptance: A failed automatic or manual import remains in the Pending Manual Imports flow with a visible error and a retry action.

items.title: Download cards overflow on mobile with long names

findings: The upstream min-w-0/break-words change still let a CSS grid track expand to the title's large min-content width: a live 390px viewport rendered the card at 778.8px. Replacing break-words with Tailwind's wrap-anywhere preserves normal word breaks while allowing the min-content width to shrink. The final browser capture measures a 358px card, 390px document width, and no horizontal overflow.
acceptance: At a 390px mobile viewport, a long unbroken release name remains inside its download card and the document has no horizontal overflow.

items.title: NZBGet reports completed, but questarr shows aborted status

findings: NZBGet history statuses beginning with SUCCESS/ are treated as completed, including GOOD, UNPACK, HEALTH, and ALL. Other status families continue through failure handling; upstream linked the correction to PR #855.
acceptance: A successful NZBGet history status such as SUCCESS/GOOD must not be reported as aborted.

items.title: Fix silent import skip when download disappears from client

findings: When a download disappears after repeated status checks, the cron handler now distinguishes disabled post-processing from enabled post-processing: the former is completed and owned, while the latter is sent to manual review. Both branches persist and publish the state change and notify the user.
acceptance: A disappearing download is never silently marked owned while post-processing is enabled; the user receives a durable manual-review item and notification.

items.title: Upgrade React to v19

findings: React, React DOM, and their type packages are on v19. Test setup guards same-element focus/blur recursion, and test-mode logging uses an in-process transport. Development and production logger-target tests now use a Writable stub so they do not start real Pino transport workers.
acceptance: The app and type declarations use React 19; focus/blur recursion remains bounded; logger tests verify target configuration without spawning transport workers.

items.title: Fix download card overflow on mobile with long names

findings: The mobile download card uses min-width safeguards and wrap-anywhere for long release names. A real browser replay at 390px confirms a 358px card and 390px document width without horizontal overflow.
acceptance: A long unbroken download name stays within its card on a 390px viewport without expanding the document.

items.title: Allow re-attempting import after a failure instead of dead-ending

findings: Automatic and confirmed import failures are persisted as retryable manual-review work with an explanatory reason. Post-import auto-delete is isolated after successful finalization, so a cleanup failure cannot demote an imported download back to retryable review.
acceptance: A failed import can be retried from manual review; a post-import delete error leaves the completed import finalized.

items.title: ⚡ Bolt: Optimize array sorting in wishlist by avoiding Date parsing

findings: Wishlist date sorting compares normalized primitive ISO date strings rather than constructing Date objects inside the sort comparator. Missing values have explicit ordering and equal values remain stable.
acceptance: Ascending and descending wishlist date sorts handle ISO strings, Date inputs, missing values, and ties without per-comparison Date parsing.

items.title: 🎨 Palette: Add dynamic ARIA labels and tooltips to download action buttons

findings: Download action buttons expose item-specific accessible names alongside their Pause, Resume, or Start Download tooltip text. Regression tests assert all three accessible names.
acceptance: Assistive technology can distinguish pause, resume, and start-download actions from their associated download or release.

items.title: I can not add this repository in Home Assistant.

findings: The reported Home Assistant checkout failure is caused by the upstream repository wiki SSH submodule and was removed upstream in PR #846. QuestarrNG has no .gitmodules or .github/wiki submodule entry, so the offending checkout requirement is absent from this fork.
acceptance: The fork can be cloned without recursively fetching the upstream SSH wiki submodule that prevented the Home Assistant repository integration from being added.

items.title: Add reverse proxy subdirectory deployment support and docs

findings: The fork supports deployment under a normalized reverse-proxy subdirectory across API routing, static assets, redirects, health checks, and Socket.IO; its operator guide documents the proxy configuration and exact mount-root behavior.
acceptance: A deployment mounted below a URL prefix serves the SPA, API, health check, and sockets under that prefix and handles the bare mount root without broken assets.

items.title: Address review feedback on qBittorrent v5+ tracking fix (follow-up to #823)

findings: Asynchronous qBittorrent adds are correlated by a unique tag with compatibility fallback when the API omits or does not apply tags, and tag cleanup is covered. Hash resolution now has one 15-second overall budget carried through polling and any re-authentication; an accepted but unresolved add remains tracked and warns users to check qBittorrent before retrying.
acceptance: Polling cannot stack repeated 30-second request timeouts; after the 15-second budget expires, no duplicate upload is attempted and the accepted download remains trackable.

items.title: Remove .github/wiki git submodule

findings: The upstream SSH-based .github/wiki submodule and its .gitmodules entry are absent from QuestarrNG, so recursive HTTPS clones do not require SSH credentials for the wiki.
acceptance: The fork has no .github/wiki gitlink or .gitmodules entry that can block Home Assistant or other HTTPS-only clone consumers.
evidence: .gitmodules and .github/wiki are absent from the fork

items.title: Rename PR template to GitHub-recognized filename

findings: The contributor template is stored at GitHub-recognized path .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md; the obsolete .github/PR_TEMPLATE.md path is absent.
acceptance: New pull requests discover the repository template automatically using a supported GitHub filename.

items.title: Stop logging idle download-status ticks so support logs don't evict real errors

findings: checkDownloadStatus returns before its info-level heartbeat when the tracked-download list is empty. A regression test now asserts that idle ticks do not emit the log line that can crowd older support evidence out of the bounded log window.
acceptance: With no active downloads, a scheduler tick does not log Checking download status; active download checks remain logged.

items.title: Option to add passwort for SABnzbd download

findings: Questarr supports both an optional per-download archive password in the Usenet download dialog and a per-downloader default. SABnzbd and NZBGet send the selected password with the job, reject password transmission over plain HTTP, and redact configured values.
acceptance: A user can provide the archive password when starting a Usenet release; it reaches SABnzbd or NZBGet safely, with the downloader default used when no per-download value is supplied.

items.title: Fix Unraid CA template category and add optional library path

findings: The Unraid XML uses the non-empty Downloaders:MediaApp:Other category and exposes an optional Game Library mount at /data. The README now explains Unraid 6.10+ local user-template installation, the templates-user destination, and the exact /data Local Path plus downloader-reported Remote Path. The repository also contains ca_profile.xml for submission metadata.
acceptance: The template parses as XML, exposes the intended category and library path, and the install guide matches the supported local user-template workflow and container path mapping.

items.title: Fix NZBGet category not applied when starting a download

findings: NZBGet addDownload chooses the request category, configured downloader category, or games fallback; tests cover configured-category and omitted-category behavior.
acceptance: A download uses the explicit request category when supplied and otherwise applies the saved NZBGet category.

items.title: Add legal disclaimer section to README

findings: README contains a Legal Disclaimer describing QuestarrNG as a self-hosted library organizer, clarifying that it does not provide copyrighted game content, and placing responsibility for third-party services and legal compliance on the operator.
acceptance: The repository README contains the requested legal and responsibility clarification.

items.title: Fix GHCR prune deleting manifests still referenced by tagged images

findings: The deployment workflow serializes runs without cancelling an active deploy, fails closed if tagged-manifest digest inspection fails, and skips deletion of untagged versions referenced by any live tag. It separately removes only stale versions whose tags are all generated test-sha values, preserving human or release tags; the digest scratch file is removed after pruning.

items.title: Fix NZBGet completed downloads reported as aborted
